title: Private House Design 120 m², Bratislava | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 120 m² private house in Bratislava: interior design (“Express” package) and electrical design. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Private house interior design in Bratislava, 120 m²

blocks.text: Private house interior design in Bratislava, 120 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed an interior design project for a 120 m² private house in Bratislava, Slovakia. The main goal was to create a contemporary, functional, and comfortable living space in which the layout, furniture, and lighting are organized around the owners’ everyday needs.

The heart of the house is a spacious living room combined with the kitchen. The layout also includes an entrance hall with storage systems, a walk-in closet, a home office, a guest bedroom, a guest bathroom, a master bedroom, a second-floor bathroom, and a boiler room.

The project was completed under the “Express” design package, with additional electrical technical documentation. The layout solutions and interior concept were developed, and a complete electrical wiring design was prepared.

The electrical documentation includes lighting plans, the placement of outlets and switches, and connection points for the necessary equipment. This approach makes it possible to coordinate the electrical systems in advance with the layout, the furniture placement, and the way each room will be used.
The house is designed in a contemporary style: a light, neutral color palette, clean lines, and a calm atmosphere for everyday life.
